author: sjm41
body:
Hi @marcfeuermann,

As discussed, here's a list of positive PAINT 'catalytic activity' annotations to fly genes that are known/predicted to encode inactive pseudo enzymes (and they have NOT annotations using IKR).  It would be good to block these if possible. (There will be more of these to add later, but here's the current list mainly taken from https://www.micropublication.org/journals/biology/micropub-biology-001425/)
FYI @rozaru.

- Aldol (FBgn0039425) gets fructose-bisphosphate aldolase activity via PTN000179343
- Trehl (FBgn0034121) gets alpha,alpha-trehalase activity via PTN004635776
- Pykl1 (FBgn0038952), Pykl2 (FBgn0031462), Pykl3 (FBgn0038258), Pykl4 (FBgn0036723), Pykl5 (FBgn0037115) gets pyruvate kinase activity from PTN000212670
- Hexl (FBgn0042711) gets fructokinase activity & glucokinase activity via PTN004516717
- Khkl1 (FBgn0036941) and Khkl2 (FBgn0036160) get ketohexokinase activity via PTN001634026
- FucTB (FBgn0032117) gets alpha-(1->3)-fucosyltransferase activity via PTN000231531
- G6pdl (FBgn0037147) gets glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase activity via PTN000604427
- Sordl (FBgn0270925) gets L-iditol 2-dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity via PTN000190705
title: Positive PAINT annotations to fly pseudoenzymes

author: marcfeuermann
body: Thanks for the list. I will check them as soon as possible.

author: marcfeuermann
body: All done. These duplication with loss of function events seem very frequent in fly. Unfortunately, they are not easy to spot during the PAINTing process. There are probably many more...

author: sjm41
body:
